column1: # Draft G08 (subchapter 6.5): WorkerRow slot states (released="taking", unreadable slot -> slot_garbled=true) and unreadable contender mark -> name_conflict_unreadable=true
# Norms: 6.5 Н2 «Выдачи», Н3 «/servers», Н3 «/metrics — текст», vectors/contender-projection (P/06.5-04, P/06.5-06)
# 1. Slot with released: "taking" -> released: false, slot_taking: true, slot_garbled: false
# 2. Unreadable slot (until: "bogus") -> slot_garbled: true, slot_until: null, released omitted
# 3. Contender mark under w-1 with mismatched name ("w-2") is unreadable -> name_conflict: true, name_conflict_unreadable: true; contender under "-" is ignored
